$comment: Phase-3 Telegram-channel listener config. The listener (scripts/telegram-listener.mjs) watches these channels for messages mentioning a data/alerts/watchlist.json ticker, dedups against the same NEWS-class ledger as the RSS poller, and pushes Telegram. Add channels by @username (public) or numeric id. Run `node scripts/telegram-session-login.mjs --list` after the session login to print your channels with ids/usernames. Set enabled:false to keep a channel configured but muted. These are tipster/news channels — the watchlist gate is the noise filter; broad macro stays the REGIME class.
